name: dsdv_seq_host_h-shph-COMMIT
purpose: S81-DV dsdv_seq_host_h: DIAGNOSTIC --cts gate, CLOSED sq+vc views, s10h lk DECLARED PIN STAND-IN (not a view); submit only after s10h lk closes

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_seq_host_c u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_DSDV_SEQHOST_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_seq_host_c.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_seq_host_c --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h/standin/dsdv_sh_lk --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_sq/views/dsdv_sh_sq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_vc/views/dsdv_sh_vc > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

hold_merge: diagnostic: lk = s10h DECLARED PIN STAND-IN (s10f --cts timing models re-shaped to the s10h outline / pin plan, not a view); swap in the s10h closed view, regate, then submit_exact
structural_change: S81-SEQHP-1021 re-pack of dsdv_seq_host_c for the RL1 lk successor s10h (388.8x453.6, p192 masters, claude/s81-shlk-1021 @254543064): vertical stack on the 43.2 lattice, lk DECLARED PIN STAND-IN (43.2,43.2) / sq CLOSED (86.4,540.0) / vc CLOSED (86.4,734.4); 43.2 channels (lk N face -> sq S face ~1,000 nets; parent M6/M7 over the M5-capped children); outline 475.2x993.6 = S81 die seqhost slot for s10h. Parent S/W/E pins = lk faces, N pins = vc N face; ck/rst_n on E in the lk|sq channel.
